unit_map: sealed Unit map carries no explicit unit definitions; runtime table governs (P3-A1 S2(e))

design_register.CC-DD-1: sign-guarded numeric lexer: a digit run preceded by [0-9A-Za-z_.-] is part of an identifier (e.g. NAME-3, V4.75), not a quantity
design_register.CC-DD-2: unit tokens start with a letter or percent; a captured unit whose base is a known length/frequency unit carrying an inverse marker (slash, caret-minus, superscript-minus) is DIMENSIONED (inverse dimension); unknown unit tokens cannot certify a dimension and pass the dimensionless validator; bare percent is dimensionless
design_register.CC-DD-3: comparison-operator variants (incl. or-similar forms and the unicode minus) normalized row-wide; multiplication-dot variants normalized only inside criterion matching (P3-A2 S2 scope)
design_register.CC-DD-4: CEIL primary window = 80 chars after the adjacency token; CEIL-FB clause = leading class keyword to next clause delimiter (semicolon or non-decimal period)
design_register.CC-DD-5: DLM primary adjacency tokens = the frozen P3-A1 S2(b) list {ceiling, bound, margin, criterion} (first present token with an adjacent quantity, 80-char window, single-shot dimensionless validation); no class-specific token list was invented
design_register.CC-DD-6: VLD f_max+margin route read literally as d <= margin x lambda_min (lambda_min = c/f_max), intersected with the E3-3(a) envelope d <= 0.3/k(f_max); the tighter governs and is reported
design_register.CC-DD-7: superscript exponents are NOT folded into numeric values (the frozen text normalizes operator variants only); a superscript-tailed exponent leaves the leading mantissa as the read value — flagged for author adjudication
design_register.CC-DD-8: P1-P6 engaged first-match-in-order (dispatch S2(a)); every additionally matching pattern is recorded in the checkpoint

anchor_texts.1: **A-1 (verdict-bearing transparency):** GW170817-class anchor — D_ref = 40 Mpc (EM-counterpart distance); f_ref = 100 Hz; criterion ℓ_att(f_ref) >= D_ref (one e-fold, conservative).
anchor_texts.2: **A-2 (reported secondary):** GWTC-3 Gpc-scale ceiling — |α_T(100 Hz)| <= 0.05 Gpc⁻¹, elected as the 90%-band edge of the measured birefringent-attenuation constraint κ = -0.019 (+0.038/-0.029) Gpc⁻¹ at 100 Hz (arXiv:2305.05844). Caveat carried: that measurement is polarization-differential; its use as a common-mode order-of-magnitude ceiling is election E6's annotation, reported, non-verdict-bearing.
anchor_texts.3: **A-3 (Phase-2 dialect band):** SME linearized-gravity bounds — isotropic k⁽⁵⁾₍V₎₀₀ <= 3.19×10⁻¹⁵ m; 16 anisotropic k⁽⁵⁾ coefficients ~10⁻¹³ m (Haegel et al., arXiv:2210.04481 / PRD 107, 064031 (2023)); d=6 non-birefringent anisotropic set (25 coefficients) per PRD 107, 124015 (2023) (arXiv:2302.05077). Binding caveat: SME coefficients are static background fields; the G-POLY1 residual is stochastic/path-random — comparison is order-of-magnitude dialect-matching ONLY, R2-estimate.
anchor_texts.4: **A-4 (validity ceiling):** f_max = 1 kHz; λ≫d margin ε = 10⁻²; admissibility requires d <= ε·λ_min in any reported window W.
